subject.title: fix: A2A handoffs can duplicate message-tool replies

question: Should OpenClaw accept this waited A2A artifact-suppression boundary for message-tool mirror and inter-session transcript rows before merge?
rationale: The patch appears correct and well-proven, but it intentionally changes message-delivery eligibility in A2A reply extraction, and green CI cannot fully settle every real channel history or stale-base merge interaction.

options.title: Accept Boundary After Refresh
options.body: Refresh against current main, preserve the newer wait-failure notification path, and land after exact-head checks because the fix is narrow and directly targets the duplicate visible-message failure mode.

options.title: Require Live Channel Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted live WhatsApp or equivalent channel transcript before merge if deterministic Gateway/qa-channel proof is not enough for this delivery path.

options.title: Defer To Broader A2A Coordination
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want the message-tool mirror, reverse sessions_send, and compaction duplicate fixes resolved under one coordinated A2A delivery plan.

recommendation.title: Accept Boundary After Refresh
